# MacroEconomics

> Oil, prices, ports and money: the data, with its seams showing. Economics datasets, repaired and charted: oil, prices, ports, the CFA franc, and the wider economy of 216 countries, markets, money, jobs and climate. Data: https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/data/ (code MIT; each source keeps its own licence, listed on the About the data page).

- [The Economy in Six Numbers: Oil, Inflation, Ports, the CFA Franc, Funding · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/): Six small economics datasets, repaired and charted with their sources and gaps shown: oil reserves counted three ways, inflation as purchasing power, port rankings, the CFA franc, quadratic funding and crypto strategies.
- [Oil Reserves and Production: Who Has the Oil and Who Is Counting · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/oil): Proved oil reserves by the US EIA, OPEC and BP side by side for 41 countries, where they disagree and why, and the ten largest producers in September 2023.
- [Inflation as Purchasing Power: What 100 from 1960 Buys Today · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/inflation): Inflation shown as purchasing power: what 100 units of money from 1960 buys each year in Australia, Austria, Belgium and Burkina Faso, plus yearly inflation for 18 World Bank rows with gaps shown.
- [Container Port Rankings 2021: Two Methods, Two Answers · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/ports): The Container Port Performance Index 2021 ranks each port by two methods. See where they agree, which ports move 10 or more places, and all 287 ports in the data.
- [The CFA Franc: Why 14 African Currencies Are Fixed to the Euro · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/cfa-franc): The CFA franc explained: two currencies, 14 countries, a fixed rate of 655.957 francs to the euro since 1999, its history, the criticisms and the case made for it, with a summary in French.
- [Quadratic Funding Calculator: How Matching Pools Favor Many Small Gifts · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/funding): Try quadratic funding: change the contributions to three projects and see how a matching pool is split. The rule explained, the inherited formula corrected, and nine other ways projects get funded.
- [Crypto Investment Strategies and How Each One Loses · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/crypto-strategies): Eight common crypto investment strategies, from dollar-cost averaging to hedging, each set beside the way it goes wrong. Not investment advice.
- [About the Data: Sources, Gaps and Repairs · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/data): Where every dataset on MacroEconomics comes from, what it covers, what is missing, and each repair made to the inherited files, with JSON downloads.
- [The World's Economies by Size, Share and GDP per Person (2023) · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/economies): The 15 largest economies in 2023, each big economy's share of world GDP since 1960, who moved up the ranking since 2000, and GDP per person for the richest and poorest, with all 185 economies in a table.
- [Population: Who Lives Where and Who Is Growing or Shrinking (2025) · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/people): The 15 most populous countries, each UN region's share of the world's people since 1960, the countries with fewer people than at their peak, and the fastest growers since 2000.
- [Inflation and Prices Around the World (2023) · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/prices): Inflation in 193 countries in 2023, the highest rates and worst years on record, world inflation since 1960, and a century of US prices.
- [Oil, Gold, Shares and Gas: Prices in the Dollars of the Day and Today's · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/markets): Brent and WTI oil since 1987, gold since 1833, the S&P 500 since 1871 with its price-earnings ratio, and US natural gas, each in nominal dollars and adjusted for US consumer prices.
- [Exchange Rates: What the Dollar Buys, 2000 to 2026 · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/money): How 22 currencies moved against the US dollar from 2000 to 2026, five major currencies indexed, and every rate in a table.
- [US Unemployment and Participation Since 1941 · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/jobs): The US unemployment rate and labour force participation rate from 1941 to 2025, with the figures in tables.
- [Energy, CO2 and the Economy: Emissions per Person and per Dollar · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/climate): Global fossil CO2 since 1750, atmospheric CO2 since 1958, emissions against income for 151 countries, the largest emitters and who emits most per person.
- [Country Explorer: GDP, People, Prices and Carbon for Every Country · MacroEconomics](https://macroeconomics.shadw.app/explorer): Choose any of 216 countries and compare two: GDP, GDP per person, population, inflation and CO2 per person over time, drawn in your browser from open data.
